name: Bertha
source:
In 1871, irish author Sheridan LeFanu began publishing a Dr. Hesselius' retelling of a certain Laura's experiences with the vampire Mircalla Karnstein (whom she knew by the name of Carmilla).

But now my attention turns towards another nested narrative: General Spielsdorf's. His niece, Bertha, had recently died, a victim of the "hellish arts" of the vampire.

It is her story with Mircalla (whom she knew as Millarca) that I'd like to explore and give proper attention to, dig up from underneath the weight of three prejudiced 19th century men.

[From [url=https://solflo.itch.io/bertha]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1871年，爱尔兰作家谢里丹·勒法努开始连载一个故事。赫塞利乌斯医生在其中转述了一位名叫劳拉的女子与吸血鬼米尔卡拉·卡恩斯坦相处的经历；劳拉认识她时，她自称卡蜜拉。

而我现在想看的，是原作里嵌套的另一段叙述，来自施皮尔斯多夫将军。他的侄女贝尔塔不久前刚去世，据说是死于这个吸血鬼的“地狱邪术”。

我想好好讲一讲贝尔塔和米尔卡拉之间的事。贝尔塔认识她时，她用的名字是蜜拉卡。我要从三个心怀成见的19世纪男人的话语底下，把这段故事挖出来，让它得到应有的注目。

（来源：[url=https://solflo.itch.io/bertha]itch.io[/url]）
